sum: Sejal Glass Limited has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE under SEBI Takeover Regulations, indicating a substantial acquisition event requiring public announcement and regulatory clearance.
detail: Sejal Glass Limited submitted a mandatory disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure signals that an acquirer has crossed (or is acquiring) a significant threshold in the company's shareholding, triggering public announcement and a statutory 4-week inspection period. The filing does not disclose the acquirer's identity, transaction value, or consideration structure in the available excerpt; those details typically appear in the full Form C filing with SEBI and in stock exchange announcements.
